folder_card_tooltip: Open folder · right click for actions
folder_delete_confirm: The folder {folder} will be deleted. Its accounts will return to the All accounts list.

guard_code_description: Use this code to sign in to {account}.

guard_link_sms_sent: Steam sent an SMS to the number ending in {hint}.

guard_login_device_approval_hint: Approve the login in the Steam mobile app, then continue.

guard_login_qr_action: Sign in with a QR code
